$comment: Steamworks achievement definitions for 뿌리째 털어라 (Uproot Heist).
Enter these on partner.steamgames.com > App Admin > Stats & Achievements > Achievements (see docs/STEAM_RELEASE.md).
apiName must match src/platform/steam.ts ACHIEVEMENT_IDS. Names and English descriptions must match src/ui/strings (ach.<ID>.name/.desc).
Korean descriptions are written as instructions ('…하세요'), unlike the in-game unlock toast ('…했어요'): Steam also shows descriptions of LOCKED achievements.
test/unit/platform-steam.test.ts fails when they drift. Icons: 64x64 JPG, unlocked + locked (greyscale) versions.

description.english: Recover loot and bank points for the first time.

achievements.unlockRule: Any recovery by the player's team that the player was holding at completion (or released within the last 3 s).

description.english: Recover an entire bank at your van.
description.koreana: 은행을 통째로 우리 차 앞까지 회수하세요.

achievements.unlockRule: A bank body recovered by the player's team with the player participating (holding / released within 3 s).

description.english: Recover a bank together with your teammate in 2v2.

achievements.unlockRule: 2v2 only: bank recovered by the player's team with both the player and the teammate bot participating.

description.english: Steal a big safe out of a bank your rival was hauling, then recover it.
description.koreana: 상대가 옮기던 은행에서 큰 금고를 빼내 회수하세요.

achievements.unlockRule: Player pulls a large safe out of a bank the opposing team was dragging (safeUnloaded.byCharId = player, bankCarrierTeam = opponent) and the player's team later recovers that safe (alone or inside a bank).

description.english: Break a fence with a bank.

achievements.unlockRule: A fence breaks against a bank the player is holding at that moment.

description.english: Complete a recovery in the final 5 seconds of a match.
description.koreana: 경기 종료 5초 전 안에 회수를 완료하세요.

achievements.unlockRule: Match ends on time; a recovery the player participated in completes within the final 5 s.

description.english: Win after trailing by more than 500 points.

achievements.unlockRule: Player's team wins after trailing by more than 500 confirmed points at some point.

description.english: Beat Hodadak in the Rival Tournament.

achievements.unlockRule: Win the best-of-3 series against Hodadak in the Rival Tournament.

description.english: Beat Tongkeun in the Rival Tournament.

achievements.unlockRule: Win the best-of-3 series against Tongkeun in the Rival Tournament.

description.english: Beat Nunchi in the Rival Tournament.

achievements.unlockRule: Win the best-of-3 series against Nunchi in the Rival Tournament.

description.english: Beat all three rivals and win the tournament.
description.koreana: 세 라이벌을 모두 이기고 대회에서 우승하세요.
라이벌 모자 세 개를 모두 모으세요.
